title: Elon Musk Largest Building: Texas AI Chip Plant
description: Reports indicate SpaceX and Tesla have selected Texas for a new AI chip manufacturing facility, which is expected to become the world's largest building.

sections.heading: Texas Selection and Building Scale
paragraphs: According to Fox Business, SpaceX and Tesla have chosen Texas as the location for an AI chip manufacturing plant. The same source reports that this facility is set to be the world's largest building.

sections.heading: Terefab Project Confirmation
paragraphs: KBTX News 3 reports that SpaceX has confirmed the Terefab project is finalized. The source notes that representatives met face-to-face with residents of Grimes County regarding the development.

sections.heading: Industry Involvement
paragraphs: Yahoo Finance published an article discussing what Intel (INTC) stands to gain from a joint venture involving a Texas chip facility.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the new Texas facility?
faq.a: According to Fox Business, the facility is intended for AI chip manufacturing.
